standard.notes: bug fix, small feature, refactor, test fix; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

risky.notes: money or trade execution, state machines, concurrency, auth, secrets, migrations, deploy or CI pipelines, data deletion; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

design.notes: multi-file design, new module, cross-repo plan; the brief makes it plan first and get the plan reviewed before code; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

large.notes: features touching many files or parts; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude; judged by Sol

ui.notes: screens, components, styling, visual bugs; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

research.notes: gather facts, compare tools, read docs; no code changes; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

rca.notes: explain a failure, find a root cause; read-only at first; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

chore.notes: stale PR triage, docs, labels, small config, watches, status checks; MiniMax and GLM 5.3 first, then GPT, then Claude

review.notes: Opus on the Max plan (the Anthropic API key has no credit since 2026-11-08); different vendor from the author

panel.notes: second opinion or panel: not routed here, pass an explicit modelSelection per seat
